training_selection: Final checkpoint candidate-1638400 only, declared before training. Require real GPU smoke/resume, mutually exclusive flag rejection, mismatched result-weight resume rejection, and float/integer/incremental export parity.
baseline_selection: The immutable net selected by the existing e20 gate and used by the full fresh Counter anchor. If e20 promotes, this is a candidate comparison with different update count as well as weight; it is not an isolated weight claim.

matches.name: wdl15-aa
matches.decision: Require all audits and paired 95% score interval containing parity.

matches.name: wdl15-gate
matches.decision: Promote only if all audits pass and paired 95% Elo lower bound exceeds zero at exactly 800 games. No extension, checkpoint substitution or pooling.

serialization: Train on CPU 0,2 with bounded writes. Wait for the full fresh Counter anchor to finish and its unit to be inactive before any new games on 4,6,8,10,12,14.
interpretation: An additional result-weight candidate after WDL40 failed its fixed gate. Its production release remains separate until the full playing gate accepts it. The selected prior net continues to be packaged.
stop_rules: C: below 25 GiB, deadline, failed prerequisite or any operational/legal audit leaves incomplete work unscored. Do not shorten fixed caps. Preserve existing checkpoints and live harnesses.
